newsitem.title: USA: RTRS-Squash-Australia's Rowland, Irving lose out in finals.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Squash-Australia's Rowland, Irving lose out in finals.

text.p: Canadian Jonathan Power became the first North American to win a major squash title when he beat Australian giantkiller Craig Rowland 15-4 9-15 15-10 16-17 15-9 in the final of the Tournament of Champions on Monday.

It was also the first time two unseeded players had contested a major final, Power having beaten world number four Peter Nicol of Britain while the ninth-ranked Rowland upset world number one Jansher Khan of Pakistan in the semifnals.
"This is not only a great victory for me but also for North American squash," said world number 16 Power after the final at the Heights Casino Club in Brooklyn.
The women's title went to Cassie Jackman of Britain, who defeated Australian Liz Irving 10-8 9-6 9-2 in the final after beating top-seeded Australian Michelle Martin a round earlier.
